ANTHILL-INTRO.title: Introduction, Vision, and Reading Guide
ANTHILL-INTRO.conjecture: Anthill's Popperian reasoning engine architecture, built on R2 sentants, provides a sound foundation for AI agents that earn confidence through surviving refutation.

ANTHILL-SENTANT.title: ANT Lifecycle, Properties, and Event Model
ANTHILL-SENTANT.conjecture: An ANT modelled as an IPUCO+D sentant with a conductor FSM, plugin bindings, and a structured working directory provides sufficient abstraction for autonomous AI reasoning.

ANTHILL-KNOWLEDGE.title: Knowledge Store and Graph Operations
ANTHILL-KNOWLEDGE.conjecture: A validated knowledge store with CBOR+Git persistence, MCP tool access, and intelligent data reduction (megabytes to ~4KB) enables AI agents to reason effectively within context window constraints.

ANTHILL-THURISAZ.title: Bayesian Epistemology and Confidence Dynamics
ANTHILL-THURISAZ.conjecture: Log-odds Bayesian updating with 12 evidence types, anti-confirmation bias mechanisms, reputation weighting, and fading foundations produces epistemically sound confidence scores that resist the confirmation bias inherent in AI systems.

ANTHILL-WORKER.title: AI Worker Supervision and Backend Abstraction
ANTHILL-WORKER.conjecture: Supervised subprocess workers with watchdog monitoring, multi-backend fallback, and follow-up queues provide reliable AI inference across heterogeneous backends.

ANTHILL-CHAT.title: Conversation Model and Command System
ANTHILL-CHAT.conjecture: A unified conversation model with slash commands, auto-follow-up, interrupt capability, and cross-channel sync provides a consistent user experience across web, Telegram, and Slack.

ANTHILL-COLONY.title: Colony Supervisor and ANT Lifecycle
ANTHILL-COLONY.conjecture: A supervisor with crash recovery, config reload from disk, and hot-add discovery provides production-grade ANT lifecycle management.

ANTHILL-TRUST.title: Colony Security and Device Provisioning
ANTHILL-TRUST.conjecture: R2-TRUST with Ed25519 colony keys, time-limited join codes, HMAC-signed WebSocket messages, and layered transport security provides defence in depth for AI agent infrastructure.

ANTHILL-RUMINATION.title: Autonomous Thinking Engine
ANTHILL-RUMINATION.conjecture: A structured 8-phase rumination cycle with synthesis, refutation, competition, and meta-cognition enables ANTs to improve their knowledge autonomously without human prompting.

ANTHILL-COMMS.title: Inter-ANT Communication
ANTHILL-COMMS.conjecture: Filesystem-based inbox/outbox messaging with Socratic discourse protocol, loop detection, and exchange caps enables productive inter-ANT knowledge exchange without infinite agreement loops.

ANTHILL-DASHBOARD.title: Web Dashboard Interface
ANTHILL-DASHBOARD.conjecture: A single-page application with real-time WebSocket updates, responsive design, and PWA support provides effective cross-device access to ANT management and interaction.

ANTHILL-GRAPH-UX.title: Knowledge Graph Visualisation and Interaction
ANTHILL-GRAPH-UX.conjecture: Interactive 3D force-directed graph visualisation with right-click editing, scoped queries, and confidence-coded rendering makes the knowledge graph accessible and actionable.

ANTHILL-WORKERS-UX.title: Task Visibility and Worker Interaction
ANTHILL-WORKERS-UX.conjecture: Real-time worker cards with progress events, preserved follow-up inputs, and question detection provide sufficient visibility and control over AI task execution.

ANTHILL-FEDERATION.title: Distributed Deployment
ANTHILL-FEDERATION.conjecture: WebSocket relay between colony nodes with R2-TRUST authentication enables distributed ANT deployment across multiple machines.

ANTHILL-ONBOARDING.title: Device Provisioning UX
ANTHILL-ONBOARDING.conjecture: QR code scanning and text join codes with a creation wizard provide a frictionless path from first visit to first ANT interaction.

ANTHILL-FILES.title: File Management UX
ANTHILL-FILES.conjecture: Sandboxed per-ANT file browsing with upload, download, and preview provides sufficient file management for AI agent workspaces.

ANTHILL-REPORTS.title: Report and Export Workflow
ANTHILL-REPORTS.conjecture: Background report generation with AI narrative, citation renumbering, and self-contained HTML output produces shareable knowledge summaries.

ANTHILL-CHANNELS.title: Multi-Channel Experience
ANTHILL-CHANNELS.conjecture: Cross-channel message sync with a clear feature parity matrix enables consistent ANT interaction across web, Telegram, and Slack.

ANTHILL-THEMATIC.title: Analysis Pipelines
ANTHILL-THEMATIC.conjecture: Braun & Clarke thematic analysis methodology applied by AI produces structured knowledge graphs, formal specifications, and test vectors from source material.

ANTHILL-EXPORT.title: Export Format
ANTHILL-EXPORT.conjecture: Self-contained HTML with embedded 3D graph, AI-written narrative, and numbered citations produces portable, human-readable knowledge snapshots.
